metadata.title: MAPP 6020.5 Rev. 3 Roles and Responsibilities of Staff in the Review (Including Collaborative Review) of Nonprescription Product Applications and Submissions under 505G of the FD&C Act
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.
metadata.applicability: FDA staff procedure. Category: New Drug Review.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: 10 Meetings (including face to face, formal teleconferences, and videoconferences) with the sponsor, applicant, or requestor during the review process should include members of the review team.
candidates.context: • Signs correspondences for PIND and IND applications. Effective Date: 1/15/97; 7/12/2007; 06/25/2018; 10/20/2026 Page 5 of 12 • Signs correspondences for OTC monograph submissions.

candidates.statement: • Final recommendations from the SSMRD should reflect the position of the SSMRD management, and for NDAs should address history of the associated prescription drug product if applicable.
candidates.context: • Participate in formal meetings with the sponsor, applicant, or requestor, as needed. SSMRD Point of Contact (POC) 11 • Receives the review request from the DRO-NPD RPM.

candidates.statement: f. Whenever feasible, the same SSMRD reviewers and ONPD reviewers who served on the initial review team should be assigned to review postapproval supplements.
candidates.context: e. ONPD will review postmarketing periodic safety reports and evaluate the need for revisions to the nonprescription drug product labeling. 4. Resolution of Differing Professional Opinions a. If there are disagreements between review team members, the disagreements will be resolved as described in MAPP 4151.8 Equal Voice: Collaboration and Regulatory Policy Decision-Making in CDER or as described in FDA Staff Manual Guides (SMG) 9010.1, 9010.2, and 9010.3.
